mechanism.claim: When at least four liquid alt perpetuals simultaneously close a completed five-minute auction beyond their own strictly prior twenty-four-hour closing range in one direction, broad crypto price discovery has entered a new value region rather than produced an isolated jump. During elevated BTC variation, follow the common barrier-discovery direction in BTC for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict direction of at least four simultaneous own-history close breakouts
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCACJP detects own-history extreme five-minute return magnitudes. Range-expansion candidates compare current bar ranges, and cross-alt traversal uses within-block excursion geometry. HVCABBD instead tests each completed close against a strictly prior rolling 24-hour close barrier and fires at irregular first-discovery times; it uses no BTC return direction, volume, flow, funding, OI, premium, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: causal trailing BTC twenty-four-hour realized variation must occupy its upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: irregular simultaneous cross-alt own-range discoveries are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: every exact UTC five-minute boundary D
features.five_minute_bar: five exact coherent native one-minute bars [D-5m,D) per symbol
features.prior_barrier_history: 288 exact complete five-minute closes [D-24h-5m,D-5m), excluding current bar
features.up_discovery: current alt close strictly greater than maximum prior close
features.down_discovery: current alt close strictly less than minimum prior close
features.broad_discovery: at least four of six alts discover in one common direction; simultaneous opposite discoveries cannot count
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC one-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D)), finite strict positive
features.variation_history: at most 8640 strictly prior source-valid five-minute decisions, minimum 6048, current excluded
features.onset: broad discovery true now and false at immediately prior exact source-valid five-minute decision; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.decision: D immediately after all seven completed five-minute bars are available
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, bar, barrier history, breadth, variation, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
